mapper.select: SELECT a.*, c.mete_name, d.device_name, e.dict_note as meteKindName FROM t_his_signal_data a left join t_cfg_mete c on a.mete_id = c.mete_id left join t_cfg_device d on a.device_id = d.device_id left join t_dict_business e on a.mete_kind = e.dict_code and e.col_name="mete_kind" where 1=1 and a.record_time BETWEEN #{startTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND #{endTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} and a.mete_kind = #{meteKind, jdbcType=INTEGER} and a.mete_id in (select mete_id from t_cfg_mete where mete_name like concat('%',#{meteName, jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')) and a.device_id in (select device_id from t_cfg_device where device_name like concat('%',#{deviceName, jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')) UNION ALL ( SELECT b.*, c.mete_name, d.device_name, e.dict_note as meteKindName FROM t_his_telemeter_data b left join t_cfg_mete c on b.mete_id = c.mete_id left join t_cfg_device d on b.device_id = d.device_id left join t_dict_business e on b.mete_kind = e.dict_code and e.col_name="mete_kind" where 1=1 and b.record_time BETWEEN #{startTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND #{endTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} and b.mete_kind = #{meteKind, jdbcType=INTEGER} and b.mete_id in (select mete_id from t_cfg_mete where mete_name like concat('%',#{meteName, jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')) and b.device_id in (select device_id from t_cfg_device where device_name like concat('%',#{deviceName, jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')) ) order by mete_name,record_time desc

SELECT a.union_id, g.mete_name, i.mete_value, a.start_time as cruiseTime, d.result_num, d.origpic, d.person_check, b.task_name, j.device_id, j.device_name, g.mete_kind, k.dict_note as meteKindName, c.instance_name FROM t_union_task a LEFT JOIN t_cruise_task_result b ON a.union_id = b.task_id LEFT JOIN t_cruise_task_result_detail c ON b.task_result_id = c.task_result_id LEFT JOIN t_cruise_data_result d ON c.cruise_result_id = d.cruise_result_id left join t_cfg_mete g on a.mete_id = g.mete_id left join t_cruise_task h on a.union_id = h.task_id left join t_cfg_data_current i on a.mete_id = i.mete_id left join t_cfg_device j on i.device_id = j.device_id left join t_dict_business k on g.mete_kind = k.dict_code and k.col_name="mete_kind" WHERE 1 =1 and a.create_time BETWEEN #{startTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND #{endTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} and a.mete_id in (SELECT mete_id from t_cfg_data_current where device_id in (select device_id from t_cfg_device WHERE device_name like concat('%',#{deviceName, jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%') )) order by g.mete_name,cruiseTime desc
